selectedSpanId.description: Optional span ID the UI wants preselected.

spanQuery.description: Case-insensitive search across span name, service name, kind, event names, link IDs, exception text, and string attributes.

showMatchesOnly.description: When true, the response may mark non-matching spans as collapsed in UI view models but must still include ancestors needed to preserve hierarchy.

logSearch.description: Optional search string applied to correlated logs returned with the trace detail.
